content: RFC 5545: DTEND non-inclusive; DATE DTSTART w/o DTEND = 1 day; DATE-TIME w/o DTEND = zero duration. UNTIL inclusive, must be UTC when DTSTART has TZID; COUNT includes DTSTART. Invalid dates (Feb 30) and nonexistent local times in DST gap MUST be ignored and not counted. Ambiguous local time = first occurrence; gap time uses pre-gap offset. Floating times have no TZID. RECURRENCE-ID;RANGE=THISANDFUTURE exists. Lines folded at 75 octets, may split UTF-8.
